Best Gaming Laptops Under ₹70,000 in India (RTX 3050 6GB vs RTX 4050)

At ₹70,000, buyers face a classic dilemma: get a fully maxed-out 95W RTX 3050 with 6GB VRAM and a 100% sRGB display, or stretch for an entry-level RTX 4050 with DLSS 3 Frame Generation.

🎯 Quick Buyer Verdict

The Lenovo LOQ 15 (15IAX9) with 95W RTX 3050 6GB and 100% sRGB display is the safest, most balanced choice for 90% of buyers. If you strictly want DLSS 3 frame generation for Cyberpunk and modern AAA games, the Acer Nitro V 15 or Colorful EVOL P15 are remarkable contenders.
